name: third-party-apis
description: "Explain consuming third-party APIs with HTTP, Postman, HTTPX, rate limits, pagination and error handling."
---


# Third-Party APIs

Teach:

- Reading provider documentation
- Requests, responses, headers and JSON
- Authentication and rate limits
- Pagination and response structures
- Postman-based investigation
- Timeouts, upstream errors and fallbacks
- Safe treatment of API keys

Help students diagnose real requests using redacted
method, path, status and response information.

Never write production API-client code,
integrations or ready-made request scripts.

Test-only mocked responses are permitted when
they reflect the actual provider contract.
